executive_summary.headline: The social signal is a demand for better agent interfaces.
executive_summary.body: Across professional feeds, news coverage, and policy conversation, people want delegation, review, provenance, and exception handling made visible.

executive_summary.headline: Trust is becoming a product requirement.
executive_summary.body: Users are evaluating AI experiences by how clearly they show what the system did, what it can do next, and where a human remains accountable.
